newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shares seen firming on telecom sector.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shares seen firming on telecom sector.

text.p: * Brazil to reveal IGP-DI inflation index for April

Brazil stocks are likely to continue climbing Monday, boosted by the telecommunications sector amid growing optimism over the Band B selloff and legislative progress on the new telecoms law, brokers said.
Last week, shares rose 4.1 percent, led by bellwether Telebras which accumulated strong gains on expectations of higher premiums on the Band B cellular concessions bidding process.
Positive outlook for the new General Telecommunications Law now before Congress is also seen driving the market higher, traders said.
Communications Minister Sergio Motta last week said he expects lawmakers to approve the law, which sets the rules for the privatization of the sector, at the latest by the end of July.
He also said he believed the law would be voted on in the lower house between May 20 and May 22, and then it would go directly to the Senate.
Analysts noted, however, they would not be surprised if some profit-taking movement occurs during the session.
They said shares have risen 49.0 percent so far this year, which may encourage some investors to "put money in their pockets."
Vale do Rio Doce off 0.7 pct at 25.60 reais
